changes.oldText: Folders created from the Data page are always User folders. Project folders are created by administrators from the admin Data pages.
changes.oldHtml: Folders created from the Data page are always User folders. Project folders are created by administrators from the admin Data pages.

changes.newText: A folder created from the Data page belongs to the currently selected project, so the project's other members can see it. To create a folder for yourself only, switch to your personal project first.
